title: OPEC Cuts Down Tanker Demand
summary:
January tanker trade data indicates strong compliance
OPEC Cuts Down Tanker Demand Fig. 1: OPEC Crude Oil Exports It appears that the whole world (at least the people that are interested in oil supply and energy prices) is watching OPEC output to see if the member countries are adhering to the crude oil production and export cuts that they promised in meetings in September and November 2016. We are curious too, particularly because of the potential impact this may have on the tanker market.
